title: GUNS AND GEAR SOUND LIKE GEAR
why: His order of 2026-10-12: add sounds for bandaging, applying armour and the rest. Swapping guns and equipping one from the backpack played the menu chirp, and dropping an item made no sound. Now a swap or an equip is a strap and holster rattle and the draw clacking up, lighter and quicker for a pistol, an SMG or the Magnum and heavier for a rifle, the LMG, a shotgun, the Longshot or the Lance; a drop is a soft thump. The sounds are the recorded CC0 foley from the v25.20 bank, and your teammates hear them where you stand. Sound only: nothing in the game changes.
now: Swapping or equipping a gun now rattles the holster and clacks the draw, and dropping an item thumps.
